sources.evidence_excerpt: INSPIRE Index Polygons is an open source dataset available under the Open Government Licence. Files are divided by local authority, published as GML, updated monthly, and each polygon has a Land Registry-INSPIRE ID relating to a registered title; the polygon extent is indicative rather than definitive.
